These small fixtures retain the exact public-task organizational mapping and OAC CLI output from the first controlled-local tau retail task 113 experiment. They are unit inputs for binding validation, not a public benchmark result. The tests derive the current WorkUnit mapping from the exact plan. OAC CLI execution itself is separately exercised by the public lab run and installed release validation. The upstream task is MIT-licensed at sierra-research/tau2-bench commit 672227c6b6676edc20d57ea53b7000262aae77b9. No full retail seed database is included here.
